title: MailerLite Automation: How to Get Started
summary: Learn how MailerLite automation works and explore common use cases. Discover how Activepieces can help you automate MailerLite workflows.
body_markdown:
## What Can You Automate in MailerLite?


MailerLite lets you bring automation to:


### Emails


An automation sequence can start the moment new subscribers sign up through a form. A common example is a welcome series that introduces your brand, delivers promised value, and builds trust over several emails.


[Pre-built templates](https://www.activepieces.com/templates) help you plug in your content and activate campaigns faster. When you run a store, you can connect Shopify to trigger buying-intent emails, such as abandoned-cart reminders, to recover lost sales.


You can also create a drip campaign for an educational course. This involves setting rules to send specific emails based on actions, and then stopping a subscriber from receiving emails once they reach a goal.


### Subscriber Updates


Changes to a custom field can happen automatically when a subscriber takes action, which keeps your targeting precise.


Each update follows a rule, and a log of subscriber profile changes can trigger an email or another update.


There’s also an option to update a field to mark when a subscriber has completed a step. You can set rules to automatically unsubscribe people based on activity, like clicking a link or staying inactive.


### Group and List Changes


Subscriber movement depends on actions such as joining a group, clicking a specific link, or completing a purchase.


Once that step happens, you can move that person into a customer group and update their status. You can even add a customer to a new group while keeping them in their current one.


Workflows can trigger when someone joins a segment based on criteria you define. Actions happen as soon as a subscriber reaches a specific point, which helps them continue into the correct group based on behavior.
